author: Sebastien Rousseau
description: How to benchmark NIST FIPS 203 (ML-KEM) and FIPS 204 (ML-DSA) operations in Crypto Service Suite with the committed benchmark code, plus the key, ciphertext and signature sizes fixed by the standards.
headline: Post-Quantum Benchmarks: Method, Sizes and Status
lead: Earlier versions of this paper published latency figures, including a WebAssembly ML-KEM-768 result of 34.1 µs, that did not come from committed code. They have been withdrawn. This page explains how to measure on your own hardware.
